title: Here Are the First Images of the Crater Left on the Moon by SpaceX’s Rocket
summary: The first images of a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket stage impact on the moon’s surface have emerged. Another image taken by the Danuri lunar satellite during one of its orbits over the impact area.
